title: Permit dates, contact roles and identifier checks
question: Which identifier, role and time relationship produced each group of matches?
finding: 32,908 distinct permit, type and state-number combinations share either identifying text or number evidence across all date relationships. 160 include an exact number in at least one additional City contact role. The rows can overlap.
how: Check every role and both building credential fields. Compare the dated state events with filing, issue and completion, retaining missing permit rows, conflicting milestones and unmatched roles. Show exact numbers, normalized numbers, different credential formats and firm-name matches separately. City business registrations use their own numbering system.
limits: An architect or engineer identifier can share digits with a CSLB licence. Firm text can refer to different holders. Events after completion or after a contact ended do not identify an improper issuance. The totals count distinct combinations within each row; summing across rows double counts overlapping roles, dates or identity evidence.
